name: Intensity-isolated Front-to-back Ray Marching
aliases: Front-to-back volume ray marching with intensity isolation mask
definition: A volume rendering technique that marches along a ray, samples voxel intensities, applies color and opacity transfer functions, isolates specific intensity ranges using a smoothstep-based mask, and accumulates color and alpha using front-to-back blending until full opacity is reached.
summary: Intensity-isolated Front-to-back Ray Marching is a volume rendering technique that restricts visual contribution to a specific scalar intensity range, reducing clutter while preserving depth-based occlusion.
